items: Preventive Maintenance, Item 1: Replace your HVAC air filter every 90 days and write the installation date directly on the filter so you always know exactly when the next replacement is due.
Preventive Maintenance, Item 2: Hose off the condenser coil on your outdoor unit twice a year, once in early spring before cooling season starts and once in early fall before heating season begins.
Preventive Maintenance, Item 3: Trim vegetation around your outdoor unit and maintain at least 2 feet of clearance on all sides to ensure proper airflow and prevent the compressor from overheating.
Preventive Maintenance, Item 4: Schedule a professional tune-up in March or early April to catch problems before peak season starts and to qualify for the 10–20% off-season discount.

Service Call Strategy, Item 1: Ask for a written quote before any work begins and verify it includes the problem description, parts with part numbers, labor hours and rate, total cost, and warranty terms.
Service Call Strategy, Item 2: Request a second quote from another company for any repair estimated at more than $500 to confirm the diagnosis and identify potentially less expensive alternatives.
Service Call Strategy, Item 3: Ask the technician directly, "What would you do if this were your house?" to shift their recommendation from revenue-maximizing to practically honest.

Service Call Strategy, Item 4: Never authorize work based on a verbal estimate — insist everything in writing so you have documented recourse if the final bill differs significantly from what was discussed.
Smart Shopping Tactics, Item 1: Buy air filters in bulk (a 6-pack) to reduce the per-filter cost and ensure you always have a replacement ready when the 90-day mark arrives.
Smart Shopping Tactics, Item 2: Clear the condensate drain line yourself using a wet/dry vac or stiff brush to avoid a service call charge for a task that takes under five minutes.
Smart Shopping Tactics, Item 3: Confirm the diagnostic fee before the technician arrives and ask whether it gets credited toward any repair work you authorize with the same company.
Smart Shopping Tactics, Item 4: Check the company website or call ahead about off-season discounts — most HVAC companies offer 10–20% off spring tune-ups scheduled before May.
